```{r drillr-runtime-support, include=FALSE}
# Helpers for checking whether submitted R code uses a requested syntax form.
# Most checks inspect parsed R code. uses_token() is available for syntax that
# R normalizes while parsing (notably the native pipe).

parse_student_code <- function(code) {
  tryCatch(parse(text = code), error = function(e) expression())
}

call_head <- function(x) {
  if (!is.call(x)) return(NA_character_)
  head <- x[[1]]
  if (is.symbol(head)) return(as.character(head))
  if (is.call(head) && identical(as.character(head[[1]]), "::")) {
    return(as.character(head[[3]]))
  }
  NA_character_
}

walk_calls <- function(x) {
  calls <- list()

  visit <- function(node) {
    if (is.expression(node)) {
      for (child in as.list(node)) visit(child)
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    if (!is.call(node)) return(invisible(NULL))

    calls[[length(calls) + 1L]] <<- node
    children <- as.list(node)[-1]
    for (child in children) visit(child)
    invisible(NULL)
  }

  visit(x)
  calls
}

uses_call <- function(code, name) {
  calls <- walk_calls(parse_student_code(code))
  any(vapply(calls, function(x) identical(call_head(x), name), logical(1)))
}

uses_token <- function(code, token) {
  grepl(token, code, fixed = TRUE)
}

call_has_named_arg <- function(code, function_name, argument_name) {
  calls <- walk_calls(parse_student_code(code))
  any(vapply(calls, function(x) {
    if (!identical(call_head(x), function_name)) return(FALSE)
    argument_name %in% names(as.list(x)[-1])
  }, logical(1)))
}

uses_assignment_equals <- function(code) {
  uses_call(code, "=")
}

drillr_exercise_checker <- function(
  label = NULL,
  solution_code = NULL,
  user_code = NULL,
  check_code = NULL,
  ...
) {
  if (uses_assignment_equals(user_code)) {
    check_code <- paste0(
      "grade_this({ fail(\"Use <- or -> for assignment. ",
      "Use = only for function arguments or defaults.\") })"
    )
  }

  gradethis::gradethis_exercise_checker(
    label = label,
    solution_code = solution_code,
    user_code = user_code,
    check_code = check_code,
    ...
  )
}

learnr::tutorial_options(exercise.checker = drillr_exercise_checker)
```

#### Data-frame Drill DF_R01: First five rows

Using single-bracket data-frame subscripting (`[rows, columns]`) and `:`, return the first 5 rows of `mtcars`. Keep all columns.

```{r df_r01, exercise=TRUE}

```


```{r df_r01-check}
grade_this({
  if (!uses_call(.user_code, "[")) {
    fail("Use single-bracket `[` subsetting as requested.")
  }
  if (!uses_call(.user_code, ":")) {
    fail("Use the `:` operator as requested.")
  }
  if (!identical(.result, mtcars[1:5, ])) {
    fail("The returned object does not exactly match the requested result.")
  }
  pass("Correct.")
})
```

      }
      if (identical(hh, "assign") && length(cc) >= 3) {
        target <- cc[[2]]
        return(is.character(target) && length(target) == 1 &&

      }
      FALSE
    }, logical(1)))

}
    if (!isTRUE(all.equal(.result, c("start", "", "end"), check.attributes = TRUE))) {

#### Vector Drill E25a: Replace one subscripted value

The vector `scores` is provided. Replace **element 3** with `99` by assigning through a single-bracket subscript, then return the modified `scores`.

```{r vector_e25a-setup, include=FALSE}
scores <- c(10,20,30,40,50)
```

```{r vector_e25a, exercise=TRUE, exercise.setup="vector_e25a-setup", topic="vector_indexing", starter_question=TRUE}

```


```{r vector_e25a-check}
grade_this({
  calls <- walk_calls(parse_student_code(.user_code))
  replacement <- any(vapply(calls, function(cc) {
    hh <- call_head(cc)
    if (!(hh %in% c("<-", "=", "<<-")) || length(cc) < 3) return(FALSE)
    lhs <- cc[[2]]
    is.call(lhs) &&
      identical(call_head(lhs), "[") &&
      length(lhs) >= 2 &&
      is.symbol(lhs[[2]]) &&
      identical(as.character(lhs[[2]]), "scores")
  }, logical(1)))
  if (!replacement) {
    fail("Replace the requested value(s) by assigning through `scores[...]`.")
  }
  if (!isTRUE(all.equal(.result, c(10, 20, 99, 40, 50), check.attributes = TRUE))) {
    fail("The vector after replacement is not correct.")
  }
  pass("Correct.")
})
```
